purpose: Answer why something was decided from memory: what, when, who (the owner or me), what replaced it. Says no record when memory has nothing.
evaluation: A why question on a saved decision gets its date, who decided and what replaced it; a topic with no memory gets 'no record'.

provenance.license: unspecified (the repo owner picks one before publishing)

portability: Plain files and the memory CLI; runs the same on the box.
